const pair: [number, number?] = [1, 2];
pair.length = 3;
const frozen: readonly [number] = [1];
frozen.length = 1;
const fixed: [number, string] = [1, "a"];
const n: 2 = fixed.length;
const rest: [number, ...string[]] = [1];
const r: 1 = rest.length;
const opt: [number, number?, number?] = [1];
const o: 1 | 2 = opt.length;
function lengthOf(p: [number, number?]): 1 | 2 { return p.length; }
console.log(lengthOf([1]));
